candidates.change_summary: Replace the external call expression to send Ether with send() (returns bool) which changes reentrancy/timing behavior and gas stipend.
Replace the external call expression with transfer(), which reverts on failure and imposes fixed gas stipend (changes observable behavior).
Move the zeroing of credit to after the external call (introduces reentrancy vulnerability altering observable state).
Remove decrement of balance (balance not updated), changing observable balance after withdrawAll.
Set credit to zero before saving old credit (incorrect order), making oCredit always the previous value and thus changing behavior when called multiple times in same call context.
